fields.meta_title: Job Posting Form Builder With HR Approval | Emergent
fields.meta_description: Build a job posting form that routes each opening for approval before it posts, then tracks how long every posting stays open. Free to start.
fields.h1: Build a Job Posting Form That Clears HR Before It Goes Live
fields.hero_description: Build a job posting form that collects each opening's title, pay range, and close date, and holds it until HR approves.
fields.features_heading: What a Posting Needs Before Anyone Sees It
fields.features_subheading: A job posting form is the request behind a public listing. Emergent builds its fields, its sign-off, and a table of open roles.
fields.feature_1:
Pay range as two numbers, not a sentence

The form asks for a low and a high figure and whether the pay is hourly or yearly. A request with the high figure below the low one goes back to the manager before HR ever opens it.
fields.feature_2:
Sign-off before the posting goes public

Each request waits for the approver you name, such as HR or a department head. They get an email or a Slack message, approve it or return it with a note, and the decision is saved.
fields.feature_3:
Location and schedule picked from a list

Managers choose the clinic, store, or campus, then the schedule: full time, part time, or seasonal. Each pick becomes a filter on the careers page and a column in the postings table.
fields.feature_4:
A close date on every posting

Ask for the date applications stop. On that date the app takes the posting down and marks it closed, unless the manager extends it first, and the request keeps its full history.
fields.feature_5:
Every posting is a row you own

Requests, approvals, and close dates sit in a database you own, not in a vendor's account. Filter by department to see what each manager has open and how long approval took.
fields.feature_6:
Export the code to your GitHub

On paid plans, export the full codebase to your GitHub repository when postings need to feed an applicant tracking system you already run, then keep building on it there.
fields.why_title: Why Build Your Job Posting Form With Emergent?
fields.why_description: An approval buried in email gets lost. Through the form, each posting keeps its pay range, its approver, and its close date on one row.

fields.tab_content_1:
No vet tech posting goes live before HR signs the pay range

Ines Okonkwo runs one of the 6 Kestrel Pine Veterinary clinics and needs a second vet tech. She fills in the job posting form: the title, full time, $19 to $23 an hour, and a close date of Dec 4. Tobiah Lund, the HR director, gets an email and approves the range. Only then does the posting go on the careers page.
fields.tab_content_2:
30-day listings that an editor reads first

Employers post seasonal and year-round jobs on Fenwick Trails Jobs, a board for outdoor work, through its submission form. Each listing names the company, the role, the location, and the pay range. Marisol Tran reads every one before it appears on the board, and an approved listing runs for 30 days.
fields.tab_content_3:
Three internships wait, each with its pay field blank

Calder Valley's career office collects internship postings from local employers through one form. This week 14 came in. The office approved 11, and the 3 that left pay blank went back to their employers with a note asking for an hourly rate, or a mark that the role is unpaid.
fields.tab_content_4:
Every posting past 45 days goes to Corvin

Twelve roles are open across the 9 Marlowe Hardware stores, each one a row with its store and the days it has been open. Any posting open more than 45 days goes to Corvin Dale, the recruiter, in a Slack direct message. Today that is 2: a cashier in Fairmount and a yard lead in Brookside.

How do I create a job posting form?

plan.angle: No live top 10 for this Wave 3 keyword, and every AlsoAsked question drifts to job-seeker advice. The searcher who wants a job posting form is the employer side: a hiring manager asking HR to open a role, a job board taking listings from employers, or a career office collecting internships. This page builds that intake form: the fields a posting needs before it goes public (title, location, pay range, description, close date), an approval step before anything is posted, and a table of every open posting with its age, so a listing filled last month does not stay up.
tab_stories: At Kestrel Pine Veterinary, clinic manager Ines Okonkwo requests a vet tech posting at $19 to $23 an hour, and HR director Tobiah Lund approves the pay range before the posting goes on the careers page.
Fenwick Trails Jobs, an outdoor job board, takes listings from employers through a submission form; Marisol Tran reviews each one and every approved listing runs for 30 days.
Calder Valley Community College's career office gets 14 internship postings from employers this week; 11 are approved and 3 wait because the employer left the pay field blank.
Marlowe Hardware tracks 12 open postings across 9 stores, and the 2 that have been open more than 45 days go to recruiter Corvin Dale.
